label: World Day of Peace
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of Peace, 1 January.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/peace on the Paul VI, John Paul II, Benedict XVI, Francis and Leo XIV pages. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'LVIII Giornata Mondiale della Pace 2025' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/peace.index.html). firstYear verified from the Paul VI shelf, which opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale della Pace 1968: 1° Gennaio, Giornata Mondiale della Pace' (https://www.vatican.va/content/paul-vi/it/messages/peace.index.html). The message is signed on 8 December of the preceding year as a rule (the 2025 message is dated 8 December 2024), which is why the id carries the occasion year, not the year of date. Verified 2026-09-12.

label: Lent message
gloss: The annual papal message for Lent.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/lent on the Paul VI, John Paul II, Benedict XVI, Francis and Leo XIV pages. Titles are dated, never numbered: 'Quaresima 2025: Camminiamo insieme nella speranza' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/lent.index.html), 'Messaggio per la Quaresima 1978' (Paul VI), 'Quaresima 1979' (John Paul II). Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Communications Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Communications Day.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/communications on the Paul VI, John Paul II, Benedict XVI, Francis and Leo XIV pages. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'LIX Giornata Mondiale delle Comunicazioni Sociali, 2025' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/communications.index.html). firstYear verified from the Paul VI shelf, which opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale delle Comunicazioni Sociali, 1967 - I mezzi di comunicazione sociale' (https://www.vatican.va/content/paul-vi/it/messages/communications.index.html). Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Day of Migrants and Refugees
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of Migrants and Refugees.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/migration on the Paul VI, John Paul II, Benedict XVI, Francis and Leo XIV pages. Benedict XVI, Francis and Leo XIV print an Arabic ordinal: 'Messaggio per la 110ª Giornata Mondiale del Migrante e del Rifugiato 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/migration.index.html); John Paul II's titles are dated only ('Giornata Mondiale delle Migrazioni, 2005') and Paul VI's three items are headed 'Giornata dell'Emigrazione' or addressed to Cardinal Baggio. The Arabic ordinals imply a first day in 1915 (100ª in 2014), but no shelf reaches it, so firstYear is not recorded. Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Mission Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Mission Day (Giornata Missionaria Mondiale).
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/missions on the Paul VI, John Paul II, Benedict XVI and Francis pages, renamed messages/mission on the Leo XIV page. Titles are dated, not numbered: 'Messaggio per la Giornata Missionaria Mondiale 2025' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/missions.index.html), 'Giornata Missionaria Mondiale, 1963' (Paul VI). One Leo XIV title prints an Arabic ordinal, 'Messaggio del Santo Padre per la 100ma Giornata Mondiale delle Missioni [18 ottobre 2026]' (https://www.vatican.va/content/leo-xiv/it/messages/mission.index.html), recorded on that document; no shelf reaches the first day, so firstYear is not recorded. Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Youth Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Youth Day.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/youth on the John Paul II, Benedict XVI, Francis and Leo XIV pages. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'XXXIX Giornata Mondiale della Gioventù, 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/youth.index.html). The John Paul II shelf opens at 'II Giornata Mondiale della Gioventù, 1987' (https://www.vatican.va/content/john-paul-ii/it/messages/youth.index.html), which implies a first day in 1986 but does not reach it, so firstYear is not recorded. One John Paul II message serves two days ('IX-X Giornata Mondiale della Gioventù, 1994-1995') and one Francis message straddles two years ('XXXVII Giornata Mondiale della Gioventù, 2022-2023'); see SERIES_OCCASION_YEARS. Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Day of Prayer for Vocations
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of Prayer for Vocations.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/vocations on the Paul VI, John Paul II, Benedict XVI, Francis and Leo XIV pages. Paul VI, John Paul II and Benedict XVI print a Roman-numeral ordinal ('L Giornata Mondiale di Preghiera per le Vocazioni, 2013'); Francis and Leo XIV an Arabic one: 'Messaggio per la 62a Giornata Mondiale di Preghiera per le Vocazioni 2025' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/vocations.index.html). firstYear verified from the Paul VI shelf, which opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale per le Vocazioni, 1964' (https://www.vatican.va/content/paul-vi/it/messages/vocations.index.html). Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Day of the Sick
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of the Sick, 11 February.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/sick on the Paul VI, John Paul II, Benedict XVI, Francis and Leo XIV pages. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'XXXII Giornata Mondiale del Malato, 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/sick.index.html). firstYear verified from the John Paul II shelf, which opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale del Malato, 1993' (https://www.vatican.va/content/john-paul-ii/it/messages/sick.index.html). The Paul VI shelf holds one earlier, unnumbered item, 'Giornata Mondiale del Malato - 1975', which predates the day John Paul II instituted in 1992 and is recorded as the shelf files it. Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Day of the Poor
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of the Poor.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/poveri on the Francis page, renamed messages/poor on the Leo XIV page. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'VIII Giornata Mondiale dei Poveri, 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/poveri.index.html). firstYear verified from the Francis shelf, which opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale dei Poveri, 2017: Non amiamo a parole ma con i fatti'. Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Day for Grandparents and the Elderly
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day for Grandparents and the Elderly.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/nonni on the Francis page, renamed messages/grandparents on the Leo XIV page. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal, and firstYear is verified from the Francis shelf, which opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale dei Nonni e degli Anziani, 2021: "Io sono con te tutti i giorni"' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/nonni.index.html). Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Children's Day
gloss: The papal message for World Children's Day.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/bambini on the Francis page. One entry as of the check, carrying a Roman-numeral ordinal and verifying firstYear: 'I Giornata Mondiale dei Bambini, 2024' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/bambini.index.html). Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Food Day
gloss: The annual papal message to the FAO for World Food Day, 16 October.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/food on the John Paul II, Benedict XVI and Francis pages. The John Paul II shelf numbers every title with a Roman numeral and opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale dell'Alimentazione, 1981' (https://www.vatican.va/content/john-paul-ii/it/messages/food.index.html), which verifies firstYear; the Benedict XVI and Francis titles are dated only: 'Messaggio per la Giornata Mondiale dell'Alimentazione 2024 (16 ottobre 2024)' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/food.index.html). Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Day for Consecrated Life
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day for Consecrated Life, 2 February.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/consecrated_life on the John Paul II and Francis pages. Titles carry a Roman-numeral ordinal: 'XXIX Giornata Mondiale della Vita Consacrata - Festa della Presentazione del Signore (1° febbraio 2025)'; the Francis 2023 entry is titled without one, which is why `ordinal` is optional even inside a numbered series (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/consecrated_life.index.html). firstYear verified from the John Paul II shelf, which opens the series at 'I Giornata Mondiale della Vita Consacrata, 1997' (https://www.vatican.va/content/john-paul-ii/it/messages/consecrated_life.index.html). The Francis titles print no occasion year outside the date parenthetical, so each has a SERIES_OCCASION_YEARS row; the Francis pages are homilies of the day by their URLs (…_omelia-vita-consacrata.html), filed by vatican.va under Messaggi. Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Day of Prayer for the Care of Creation
gloss: The annual papal message for the World Day of Prayer for the Care of Creation, 1 September.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/cura-creato on the Francis page, renamed messages/creation on the Leo XIV page. Titles are dated, not numbered: 'Messaggio del Santo Padre in occasione della Giornata Mondiale di Preghiera per la Cura del Creato [1° settembre 2024]' (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/cura-creato.index.html); two entries print an ordinal ('VI Giornata Mondiale' in 2020, 'XI Giornata Mondiale' in 2026), which disagree with each other by one and are recorded as printed. The shelf opens with the letter of 6 August 2015 instituting the day, filed as its 2015 entry. No shelf reaches a 'I Giornata', so firstYear is not recorded. Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Tourism Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Tourism Day, 27 September.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/tourism, present for John Paul II. Titles are dated, not numbered, and print the occasion date only inside the parenthetical: 'Messaggio per la Giornata Mondiale del Turismo (27 settembre 2004)'; the shelf runs 1982-2004 (https://www.vatican.va/content/john-paul-ii/it/messages/tourism.index.html), and each item has a SERIES_OCCASION_YEARS row. Verified 2026-09-12.

label: World Literacy Day
gloss: The annual papal message for World Literacy Day (Giornata Mondiale dell'Alfabetizzazione).
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/literacy, present for John Paul II. Titles are dated, not numbered: 'Giornata Mondiale dell'Alfabetizzazione 2003'; the shelf runs 1979-2003 (https://www.vatican.va/content/john-paul-ii/it/messages/literacy.index.html). Verified 2026-09-12.

label: Urbi et Orbi, Christmas
gloss: The Christmas Day Urbi et Orbi message and blessing, 25 December.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/urbi (Pius XII, John Paul II, Benedict XVI, Francis, Leo XIV) or messages/urbi_et_orbi (John XXIII, Paul VI). The shelf is shared with the Easter series and with every other Urbi et Orbi; titles are inconsistent ('Messaggio Urbi et Orbi - 1975', 'Messaggio natalizio e Benedizione “Urbi et Orbi” 2021'), so membership is assigned by date: an item dated 25 December belongs here (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/urbi.index.html). Verified 2026-09-12.

label: Urbi et Orbi, Easter
gloss: The Easter Sunday Urbi et Orbi message and blessing.
note: vatican.va sub-shelf messages/urbi (Pius XII, John Paul II, Benedict XVI, Francis, Leo XIV) or messages/urbi_et_orbi (John XXIII, Paul VI). The shelf is shared with the Christmas series and with every other Urbi et Orbi; membership is assigned by date: an item dated Easter Sunday by the Gregorian computus belongs here. Every other item on the shelf (the Momento straordinario di preghiera of 27 March 2020, a first blessing after election, a Jubilee closing) is an Urbi et Orbi with no series (https://www.vatican.va/content/francesco/it/messages/urbi.index.html). Verified 2026-09-12.
